description: This bar chart illustrates the performance comparison of three different schema linking modules—DIN-SQL (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot)—across three evaluation metrics: Recall, Precision, and F1 Score. The horizontal axis categorizes the metrics, while the vertical axis represents the performance score on a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100. Each metric category contains three adjacent bars, colored light blue for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), dark blue for TA-SQL (zero-shot), and light green for DIN-SQL (few-shot), with exact numerical values labeled directly above each bar. For Recall, the DIN-SQL (zero-shot) module achieves a score of 63.58, TA-SQL (zero-shot) achieves 71.90, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) achieves 72.29. For Precision, DIN-SQL (zero-shot) scores 88.89, TA-SQL (zero-shot) scores 91.24, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) scores 92.31. For F1 Score, DIN-SQL (zero-shot) scores 75.34, TA-SQL (zero-shot) scores 80.40, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) scores 81.08. The bars are grouped side-by-side within each metric category, and the chart does not indicate any sorting order or visual emphasis such as shading or bolding for any specific bar.
